snapshot.title: TNPSC REVISION: General Studies Finale
snapshot.exam_hook: ⚡ TNPSC GS Hook: GS complete. Everything connected. History to Digital. Accuracy is key. Victory. ⚡ v12 Stamina Hook: 60-min Sprint active.

quick_notes.title: Unit 8 & 9 Recap
quick_notes.explanation: Sangam literature refers to ancient Tamil poems written between 300 BCE and 300 CE, which show the culture and society of that time. Periyar E. V. Ramasamy was a social reformer who fought for equality and justice, especially for lower castes and women. The 69% reservation means that in Tamil Nadu, 69% of government jobs and college seats are reserved for people from backward classes, scheduled castes, and scheduled tribes to reduce social inequality. TNeGA stands for Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency, which is a government body that uses digital technology to make public services available online for citizens.

quick_notes.title: Geography Recap
quick_notes.detail: NE Monsoon (TN Rain). Muppandal (Wind). Doddabetta (Nilgiris). Kallanai (Oldest Dam).
quick_notes.explanation: The Northeast Monsoon (NE Monsoon) is a seasonal wind pattern that brings most of the rain to Tamil Nadu (TN) during the winter months. Muppandal is a village in Tamil Nadu known for having strong, steady winds, so it is used for wind energy generation, meaning windmills there turn wind into electricity. Doddabetta is the highest mountain peak in the Nilgiri Hills, which are a mountain range in southern India. Kallanai is an ancient dam built across the Kaveri River, and it is the oldest dam in India still in use, constructed over 1,500 years ago.

quick_notes.title: History Recap
quick_notes.explanation: Francis Day was a British official who founded the city of Chennai, originally called Madras, in 1639. Rajaji, whose full name was C. Rajagopalachari, was a leader in India's freedom movement who organized the Vedaranyam Salt March in 1930 to protest British salt laws. In 1801, the British established the Madras Presidency, which was a large administrative region covering much of present-day Tamil Nadu and parts of neighboring states. The Theosophical Society, which promotes spiritual understanding among different religions, established its international headquarters in the Adyar area of Chennai in the late 1800s.

quick_notes.title: Polity & Economy Recap
quick_notes.explanation: The Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly has 234 seats, meaning that is the total number of elected members who represent different areas of the state. The Tamil Nadu Legislative Council, which was a second, upper house of the state legislature, was abolished in the year 1986, so now the state has only one legislative house. Article 280 of the Indian Constitution establishes the Finance Commission (FC), a body that decides how tax money is shared between the central government and state governments. The 101st Amendment to the Constitution, passed in 2016, introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST), which is a single, nationwide tax on the supply of goods and services that replaced many older taxes like sales tax and service tax.

quick_notes.title: Current Recap
quick_notes.detail: Puthumai Penn (Higher Ed). 44th Chess Olympiad. 38 Districts.
quick_notes.explanation: Puthumai Penn is a Tamil Nadu government scheme that provides financial help to girls from poor families so they can continue their education after high school, specifically for higher education like college or university. The 44th Chess Olympiad was a major international chess competition held in 2022 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, where teams from many countries played against each other. Tamil Nadu now has 38 districts, which means the state is divided into 38 separate areas for local administration, each with its own district collector and government offices.
